To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the permeability of nanofiber is greater than that of plane drug and nanofibers show steady-state drug permeation.
the ciprofloxan-loaded nanofibers have higher drug permeability through different biological membranes.

the permeability of nanofiber was significantly higher than the plain drug and the permeability through the intestine was maximum followed by eye, sublingual mucosa, trachea mucosa, rectal mucosa, and skin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel drug delivery system for ciprofloxaxin.
the development and evaluation of a new nanofiber-based system to improve the permeability and bioavailability of the drugs.
the permeability of the nanofibers and their potential application for drug delivery system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
nanofiber is a promising drug delivery vehicle for ocular and pulmonary diseases.
ciprofloxacine-loaded polyvinyl alcohol ultra-thin nanomembranes are a potential drug delivery system for various mucosal membranes.
the drug permeation from the ultrathin nanofibers is higher than the plane drug and the nanofibers can be used as encapsulated carrier system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
nanofiber-based delivery systems could be a promising alternative for the delivery of ciproflovacin.
the permeability of the nanofibers is dependent on the type of membrane and the nanofiber structure.
nanofiber can be used as a potential carrier system for drug permeation through different mucosal membranes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the permeability studies are important to understand the drug absorption, distribution, and metabolism.
the drug release from nanofiber can be tailored by varying its thickness and the drug loading capacity.
the permeability of nanofibers through various biological membranes can be controlled to achieve the desired release rate and thereby therapeutic outcomes.
